params.body:
## What happened

On 2026-10-23 athena OV4 reported that the whole "Deel 1 - Basisvorming" section was gone from report preparation for every 2nd and 3rd grade class (3GR among them).

Checked on a production dump of the same day:

- At 08:23 a teacher linked to athena Heule and athena OV4 (user 9249) was removed on the staff screen. `StaffController::destroy` marks the user `DELETED`, for every school at once.
- The `User` global scope hides `DELETED` users everywhere, also as the author of a feedback. Her 40 period-1 feedbacks in the basisvorming came back with `teacher: null`.
- `ReportPreparationSection.vue` read `feedback.teacher.first_name`, threw, and rendered nothing, title included. She had only written basisvorming feedback in the 2nd and 3rd grade, so exactly those sections vanished (21 pupils, only OV4).
- The student page reads `$generalFeedbackItem->teacher->first_name` the same way; with one of her 3 general feedbacks it throws (500 in the test).

The basisvorming query itself is fine: on the dump it returns all 15 clusters for 3GR.

## Changes

1. **Feedback keeps its author when the author is removed.** The User scope gets a name, `User::NOT_REMOVED_SCOPE`. Both feedback relations drop only that scope, so the feedback stays on the report with the teacher's name. The Vue components and the student page read the author with a guard, so one feedback without an author cannot take a section down.
2. **Every creator stays known.** The `creator` of an evaluation, a score, a project, a class group and a cluster (and through it the three course models) had the same hole. The evaluation creator shows in the score popups of report preparation. These relations drop the scope too.
3. **Removing a staff member removes them from this school only.** `destroy` detaches the staff member from the selected school. The user becomes `DELETED` only when no school is left, and the message says which of the two happened.

## Tests

- `FeedbackOfARemovedTeacherTest`: the API keeps the removed author's name, the student page shows the general feedback, and no Vue component reads `feedback.teacher.x` without a guard. 3 red on main, green here.
- `EveryAuthorStaysKnownTest`: walks every model and fails on a `creator` or `teacher` relation to `User` that still hides a removed user. 8 on main, 0 here.
- `RemovingAStaffMemberTest`: a teacher of two schools stays active at the other one; a teacher of this school only is removed. 2 red on main, green here.

Full suite on MariaDB: the same 21 failures as plain `main` on the workbench (Chrome printing, Vite manifest, BuildStamp), nothing new.

Verified on the 2026-10-23 dump: with this branch all 50 report preparation calls for OV4 pupils (Deel 1 and 2) carry an author.

## After merge

User 9249 is still `DELETED` in production. Whether she stays at Heule is for the school to say. If she does, set `status` back to `ACTIVE`, then remove her from OV4 on the staff screen, which now detaches only OV4.
params.title: A removed teacher no longer takes her feedback, or Deel 1, with her
